profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Capital One

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Solution Architect
positions.description:
• Developed and recreated design fabrication code to support 100s of users on a daily basis.
• Optimized the primary organizational system, which processes 5000 requests annually for the production
of prototype parts in fabrication shops.
• Leveraged tools such as Power Apps, SharePoint, and Power Automate to improve site functionality

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Developed and tested Vitech's backend Java-based insurance and pension administration system using the AGILE process.
• Collaborated with the product development team to enhance disbursement features and meet client requirements.
• Utilized Java, Spring Framework, Hibernate, PostgreSQL, SVNTortoise, Oracle SQL and RESTful web services.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Oracle Database · SQL · PostgreSQL · Hibernate · Jira · Spring Framework · Git · Model-View-Controller (MVC) · Core Java

positions.title: Lead Web Developer and Digital Manager
positions.description:
•	Created timely updates, functionality, and backend support for over 45,000 unique website visitors and over 100 Pitt News employees.
•	Collaborated with a team of editors and designers to optimize website content and user experience.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained code to support ongoing website updates and features for a site with 2000+ daily visitors.
• Designed and developed an admin system for website content management.
• Troubleshot various website issues and resolved bugs.

positions.title: IT System Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and developed an internal web-based inventory system for a construction company with a workforce of over 500 employees.
• Successfully implemented the system, resulting in streamlined inventory management and improved operational efficiency.
• Built front end and back end using PHP, SQL, Bootstrap and Smarty.
• Presented a PowerPoint presentation on the inventory system to executive management.
